definition: Unverified but widely circulated survival information passed orally or through low-bandwidth Diaspora nodes among the Gray Zone residents — tips on which Ferrogate checkpoints are bribable, which food aid is contaminated, which ELFs are safe to negotiate with. Treated as sacred knowledge by those who depend on it.
origin: the Gray Zone community oral tradition, borrowing religious framing as ironic self-awareness
usage: Exclusively Tier 1 and the Gray Zone communities; using the term outside those contexts reads as mockery
example: the Gray Zone gospel said the Carrion drop point on Pier 9 was clean, and so far the Gray Zone gospel had never lied to Okonkwo.
